claim.claim-text: 2. The cartomizer of claim 1, wherein the heater coil housing (323) comprises first and second notches complimentary to the first and second notches (363<1>,363<2>) provided in the heater coil support (325).

3. The cartomizer of claims 1 or 2, further including a first seal (347) placed around the neck portion (328) of the heater coil housing (323), the seal (347) sealing a first end of an inner tube to the heater coil housing.
4. The cartomizer of any of one the previous claims, wherein the base plate portion (361) includes first and second air inlets (326<1>, 326<2>) on opposite sides of the heater coil (318).
5. The cartomizer of claim 4, wherein the first and second air inlets (326<1>, 326<2>) are formed by air inlet tubes (362<1>, 362<2>).
6. The cartomizer of any one of the previous claims, wherein portions of the wick (319) are compressed by the first and second notches (363<1>,363<2>).
7. The cartomizer of any one of the previous claims, wherein the wick (319) is held in place between the heater coil housing (323) and the coil support (325).
8. The cartomizer of any one of the previous claims, wherein a first end of the cartomizer is adapted to be inserted into a battery assembly (114), preferably via a friction fit.

9. The cartomizer of any one of the previous claims, wherein the wick (137) extends through a center of the heater coil (124) and through a first port (139<1>) in a first wall of the heater coil casing and through a second port (139<2>) in a second wall of the heater coil casing.
10. The cartomizer of claim 9, wherein the first and second ports (139<1>, 139<2>) have a diameter less than a diameter of the wick (319).
11. The cartomizer of any one of the previous claims, wherein the inner tube (118) and the heater coil housing (127) are connected by an interference fit.

12. The cartomizer of any one of the previous claims, wherein a second end of the inner tube (118) is connected to inserted to a proximal seal (121), the proximal seal (121) placed between the inner tube (118) and a mouth piece (102), the mouthpiece (102) having an outlet (103).
13. The cartomizer of any one of the previous claims, wherein the mouthpiece (102) is attached by a snap fit.
14. An electronic smoking device comprising a cartomizer according to any one of claims 1-13.
